title: Companion Fare Tariff for Crestline Companion Certificates and Passes
content:
**Clause.** Under Crestline Companion Certificates and Passes, the companion fare of a booking is the product's companion base fare — the base fare the holder pays for the companion per trip, before taxes, as published for the product the booking is made on.

## Composition of the fare charged

- **Starting fare** — the fare from which the charge is worked out.
- **Fare after the discount** — the starting fare multiplied by one minus the discount percentage.
- **Companion fare charged** — the fare after the discount less the credits on the fare, subtracted together from it, never below zero, rounded half up to the cent.

## Worked figure (hypothetical inputs)

| Step | Value |
|---|---|
| Product's companion base fare | 119.00 USD |
| Starting fare | 119.00 USD |
| Companion fare charged | 119.00 USD |

**Which fare is read?** The companion base fare of the product the booking is made on; each product publishes its own.

**Rounding.** Every rounding in this rule is half up to the cent, a value lying exactly on a half cent going up to the next cent.
